verses.1: Thus I saw Adonai Yehovah, and behold, a young lion.
verses.2: And he said, “What do you see? It’s a burdened and tired person.” But the Lord said, “Come, my child, to my people Israel. I will not let him go any further away from me.”
verses.3: And on that day, the songs of the temple were sung. “May the Lord Jehovah be glorified!” May He be praised everywhere.
verses.4: Hear this: they are those who bring forth sons and daughters, and who help the poor of the land.
verses.5: And it was said, “The new month will pass by, and the Sabbath will be over. It will be time to increase the weight and to open up the ears of deceit.”
verses.6: To purchase goods and utensils with money, as well as shoes and other necessities for wearing.
verses.7: May the LORD be praised with great glory, in the name of Jacob. Even if I forget all his deeds forever.
verses.8: Do not let this cause the earth to be destroyed. But all those who live on it will be destroyed as well. Everything will be destroyed, just like in Egypt.
verses.9: And on that day, Adonai Yehovah will say, “I will bring the sun out in its might at dawn, and I will darken the earth during the day.”
verses.10: And I have turned your festivals into mourning, and all your songs into wails. I have covered all your gifts with a veil, and all your heads with snow. I will make them stand as a single tomb, and tomorrow they will be buried in it.
verses.11: Look, days are coming, says the Lord God. I will send famine upon the land—not just famine for food, but also for water to drink. This will happen because people will not listen to the words of the Lord.
verses.12: And they traveled from sea to sea, from north to south. They sought out God’s will, but they couldn’t find it.
verses.13: On that day, the beautiful curtains and decorations will be destroyed.
verses.14: They blasphemed against Shomeron and said, “May your God live!” They also said, “May he live through the seven days.” But they fell down and never got up again.
